text:
Maya (New Hire): Morning — I'm Maya, starting next Mon. Quick q: passport renewal in progress; can I complete the I-9 remotely or do I need to bring other docs? Also laptop pickup window? Thanks!

Aisha (People Ops): Welcome Maya! You can do remote I-9 if you use an approved notary or if you visit a kiosk. For passport renewal, bring your driver's license + renewal receipt if possible. Ping me your case # and I'll double-check. Laptop: IT offers same-day pickup at HQ 9-5 or we can courier it. Which do you prefer? @Sam (Facilities) for desk/shuttle details.

Maya (New Hire): Thanks Aisha. Prefer courier to my address. Is that same-day? Also do I need to upload background-check consent anywhere?

Ben (People Ops): Courier typically ships next business day if the address on file is verified. For background check: complete the e-sign link from Checkr (you should have an email). If you didn't get it, we'll resend. Also please finish benefits basic forms in BambooHR before day 7 so enrollment isn't delayed.

IT Helpdesk: Hi Maya — to provision the laptop we need your shipping address and preferred delivery window. We'll image the device before shipping; when you boot the first time connect to Wi‑Fi and run:

```
bash -c 'curl -sS https://redwood.ai/setup | bash'
```
We can also do a Zoom session for first-boot provisioning if you'd like.

Maya (New Hire): I didn't get the Checkr link. My address is 1234 Maple St, Apt 5, San Francisco, CA 94107. Best delivery window 10:00–16:00. Zoom provisioning would be great.

Aisha (People Ops): Resent Checkr invite just now — check spam too. Please complete by EOD Friday to avoid hold on payroll/benefits. For remote I-9 with an electronic notary, approved options are: remote-notary.com or a bank notary. If you go to a bank notary bring renewal receipt + another photo ID. I'm tagging @notary-bot for available kiosk slots and remote voucher codes.

notary-bot: Available HQ kiosk slots: Mon 08:30–09:30, Mon 12:00–13:00. Remote notary voucher: code RW-REMOTE-01 (valid until next Tue). If you pick kiosk, reply with preferred slot and we'll reserve it.

Sam (Facilities): :wave: If you opt for pickup, desk A-14 is reserved for you Mon morning. Shuttle from Civic Center BART departs at 08:40 and stops at Embarcadero at 08:50. If courier, I'll coordinate signature access with the carrier.

Maya (New Hire): Courier please. I'll complete Checkr when it arrives and will take the Zoom provisioning. Appreciate the help!

Aisha (People Ops): :thumbsup: Got it — I'll confirm the courier label and mark your onboarding checklist. Welcome aboard, Maya :tada:
